title: "RIVERSEA project"
engine: knitr

This site gathers the work of the RIVERSEA project, quantifying how dams and
nutrient loading affect fish food web structure along the river-estuary-sea
continuum in France.

- [**Lab notebooks**](analysis/index.qmd) — notebooks tracking the
  exploratory, day-to-day analysis of the project.
- [**Reports**](output/index.qmd) — the manuscript and, in time, synthetic
  reports documenting the finalized analysis pipeline.
- [**Presentations**](presentations/index.qmd) — slides presented at meetings
  and conferences.
